# Semantic publication authority: live-source audit

14 October 2026. Read-only source review. The file-level SHA-256 locks in [source-lock.json](source-lock.json) apply to every `src/` line cited below; they lock the **live** VDOM (`cdc774…`), not the archived original (`00d851…`). The normative target is [master plan §5 and §17](../../final-master-plan.md): prepared → admitted → applying → published, or applying → failed-partial; old managed accepted views during application, exact captured acknowledgement and one callback-free group publication before notifications. That complete contract is **proposed**, not implemented. Dense physical optimization remains on hold under the final disposition. This audit makes no speed claim.

## Narrow integration prescription and prerequisites

1. **Specify the receipt and accepted observation API before changing fast paths.** Receipt must carry exact Root/World cell cut, collection `read.toVersion`, Store reader cut, VDOM structural base, host domain, candidate owners, and publication membership. State `admitted` only after the last preparation callback and final freshness/writer-lifetime validation. Preserve current World, Root history, VDOM sink cache, Store selector maps and collection reader versions as *different roles*; do not infer that matching scalar values make their authorities interchangeable. Prerequisite: decide which managed readers can observe accepted state and what grouped roots share a publication boundary.
2. **Converge direct numeric and direct keyed delta on one host-application authority.** Retire their independent `#commitHostMutation` acceptance and scattered `#lastSourceValues`/pending/reader ack sequencing only when the receipt publishes their exact cuts after host success. Keep the physical caches and narrow compiled paths. If any host writer throws, mark failed-partial, retain prior accepted frontier and cut, stop writes and require explicit remount/dispose; do not replay it. Do not remove exact World/Root pending or accepted history. The direct keyed path must defer owner retirement/ref/effect callbacks until its maps and ack are published.
3. **Make candidate and grouped publication one declared semantic boundary.** Candidate host commits may remain sequential because arbitrary host writes are physical. Stage Root tree/cache/history, Store selector history, collection acks and VDOM accepted metadata so a callback-free publication step advances every member together, then run Store notifications, refs and effects. Distinguish postpublication callback errors from host/receipt failure. Align queue version map with the same accepted receipt, rather than treating it as an independent success oracle. This requires a concrete safe rule for publish-time failures; Map or subscription updates that can throw after the first pointer swap must be moved before admission or made infallible. Do not merely add another version counter or promise rollback of arbitrary host writes.
4. **Preserve terminal resources and disposal as a separate lifetime axis.** `hostDisposed` can prevent duplicate host disposal while a domain is failed-partial; it is not an accepted value. Define deferred teardown while applying and quarantine/remount after failure. A disposed root intentionally drops pending work, whereas a live quarantined root must retain the failed receipt for diagnosis and avoid automatic retry.

Required adversarial verification for a later implementation (none executed here): second of several host writers throws; host setter dispatches a newer cell version and attempts nested flush/update/dispose; getter revokes a prepared binding at admission; host write changes task-only input; second root fails during host apply and during publish; Store selector switches and subscriber reenters; collection listener adds a newer batch while an older `toVersion` commits; keyed owner removal/reinsert with ref/effect throw; two forks observe different accepted versions; old accepted managed reads while applying; postpublication callback throws without poisoning successful history; explicit quarantine then dispose/remount. Assert host effect order, unchanged old accepted frontier on failed-partial, exact pending cutoff, one group publication point and no replay of partially applied custom writers. This is a proof/verification obligation, not a report of tests.
